data.name: Ibraheemiyah
data.gender_notes: Ibraheemiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Derived from Ibraheem, father of many
data.long_meaning: Ibraheemiyah is a feminine name derived from Ibraheem, meaning 'father of many'. It signifies a connection to the Prophet Ibraheem, known for his faith and leadership. The name Ibraheemiyah carries the meaning “Derived from Ibraheem, father of many” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibraheemiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody derived from ibraheem, father of many and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Prophet Ibraheem is described as a just and righteous leader (Quran 16:120). The name Ibraheemiyah embodies these qualities, symbolizing righteousness and devotion.
data.etymology: Ibraheemiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Derived from Ibraheem, father of many.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibraheemiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: إبراهيمية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من إبراهيم، رمز للإيمان والتوحيد
in_arabic.long_meaning: إبراهيمية هو اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من اسم إبراهيم، الذي هو اسم للخليل عليه السلام. هذا الاسم يحمل معاني الإيمان، التوحيد، والتوكل على الله. يعتبر إبراهيم عليه السلام من أهم الأنبياء في الإسلام، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم في عدة سور، مما يجعل الاسم ذا قيمة دينية وروحية عالية.

in_english.name: Ibraheemiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ibraheem, symbolizing faith and monotheism
in_english.long_meaning: Ibraheemiyah is a feminine name derived from Ibraheem, the Arabic name for the Prophet Ibrahim (Abraham), who is considered a significant figure in Islam. The name embodies the meanings of faith, monotheism, and trust in God. Prophet Ibrahim is a pivotal prophet in Islam, mentioned in several chapters of the Quran, which renders the name rich in religious and spiritual significance. The name Ibraheemiyah reflects the values of devotion, loyalty, and spiritual commitment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ibraheemiyah holds a profound cultural significance as it is connected to one of the most influential figures in Islamic history, Prophet Ibraheem (Abraham). This prophet is revered across different Abrahamic faiths and is regarded as a model of faith and obedience. Naming a child Ibraheemiyah highlights a deep connection to this beloved figure, not only in terms of lineage but also in emulating the unwavering faith and steadfastness that he exemplified. Furthermore, the name serves as a reminder of the Prophet's lessons and contributions to Islamic culture.
data.spiritual_significance: Ibraheemiyah, as a name that traces its roots back to Prophet Ibraheem, carries a rich spiritual meaning. Prophet Ibraheem is widely regarded as a messenger of God, who showed unwavering faith and obedience to God's will throughout his life. By giving a child this name, parents are making a spiritual commitment to instill in their child the qualities and teachings of this revered figure – faith, obedience to God, steadfastness, and a devotion to leading a righteous life. Additionally, the name serves as a constant reminder for the child to turn to God and seek guidance and strength in times of need, just as Prophet Ibraheem did throughout his life.
